notes.title: Fritz 20 SE - available on Steam on 16.09.2025!
notes.content: [h1]Fritz 20 SE from 16.09.2025 on Steam[/h1][h1]Special launch [b][u]discount[/u][/b] available on Steam![/h1][p]The wait is over Fritz 20 SE is here with more power, style, and training options than ever before![/p][p]Look forward to Fritz 20 SE. This is new: [/p][p][b]Compete against legends [/b][/p][p]Compete with the strategies of the greatest players in history: Morphy, Lasker, Capablanca, Tal, Fischer, Karpov, - with an ELO adapted to you, but in an authentic style.[/p][p][b]More highlights in Fritz 20 SE:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fritz engine now with 3,580 ELO - world-class level[/p][/*][*][p]Manual opponent configuration[/p][/*][*][p]New game styles: "Romantic" and "Hypermodern"[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet training, AI chat, new 3D visuals, game controller support, new achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Configure opponent simulation from ChessBase 18-Style Reports[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fritz 20 SE will be released on Steam on 16.09.2025![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841830/Fritz_Chess_20_Steam_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][b]Dear chess fans,  [/b][/p][p]Fritz 20 SE will soon be available on Steam! As a ChessBase customer, you have the opportunity to use the latest version of the legendary chess software right here. [/p][p][b]Stay tuned! [/b][/p]
